close_reason: Fixed: check_critical_extensions now uses .as_deref().unwrap_or(&[]) pattern consistent with other extension helpers
description: pkix-path/src/lib.rs:1015 — check_critical_extensions uses 'if let Some(exts) = cert.tbs_certificate.extensions.as_ref() { for ext in exts { ... } }', while every other extension-accessing helper in the same file (find_cert_ext, has_delta_crl_indicator, issuer_has_crl_sign, cert_is_ca_cert, etc.) uniformly uses .as_deref().unwrap_or(&[]).iter(). The if-let form also silently skips the loop body on None, which is correct, but the inconsistency is a distraction. Fix: replace with extensions.as_deref().unwrap_or(&[]).iter().find(...).is_some() or iterate via the canonical pattern to match the rest of the file.
title: R4: pkix-path lib.rs: check_critical_extensions uses inconsistent extension access pattern
